categories.main_business_segments: LD Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing of paper packaging products including corrugated boxes, color boxes, eco-friendly paper bags, and industrial paper. The company also engages in printing technology, packaging design, R&D, intelligent manufacturing, and integrated packaging solutions, serving diverse sectors such as cosmetics, food and beverage, electronics, and logistics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced digital printing, intelligent manufacturing, and automation technologies, integrating IoT, blockchain, and big data platforms to enhance production efficiency and product customization. It emphasizes lightweight, high-strength packaging design with patented structural innovations and environmentally friendly materials, supported by a smart factory model and Industry 4.0 standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: LD serves a broad customer base across fast-moving consumer goods, high-end food and beverages, cosmetics, electronics, outdoor products, home appliances, agricultural products, photovoltaic, tobacco and alcohol, express delivery, and hazardous goods packaging sectors. Its markets include both domestic Chinese regions and international clients, with a focus on providing customized packaging solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are primarily concentrated in China, especially in the East China region including Shanghai and Anhui province. It also has growing export sales to overseas markets, accounting for a smaller but increasing portion of revenue. Key facilities include the Shanghai and Anhui manufacturing and R&D centers.
categories.supply_chain_position: LD operates mainly in the midstream segment of the packaging supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and printing of paper packaging products. It sources raw materials like paper and auxiliary materials from upstream suppliers and delivers finished packaging products directly to downstream customers in various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in green and sustainable packaging materials, intelligent packaging with traceability and anti-counterfeiting features, and digital printing technologies. It invests in smart factory development, automation, and digital transformation to enhance customization capabilities and operational efficiency, aligning with national green economy and low-carbon policies.
categories.revenue_model: LD generates revenue primarily through direct sales of customized paper packaging products and printing services. It operates on a make-to-order production model with direct sales channels domestically and internationally, with pricing based on cost-plus and market negotiation mechanisms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading high-tech enterprise in China's paper packaging and printing industry, recognized for intelligent manufacturing and innovation. It competes in a fragmented market with many small and medium enterprises, aiming to increase market share through technology leadership and comprehensive packaging solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, LD reported revenues of approximately RMB 816 million, a 14.46% increase year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 3.78 million, improving from the previous year. The company has total assets exceeding RMB 2.25 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D and infrastructure, showing steady revenue growth despite profitability challenges due to new facility depreciation and impairment provisions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: LD emphasizes its technological innovation, intelligent manufacturing capabilities, and commitment to sustainable, eco-friendly packaging solutions. Its competitive advantages include patented packaging designs, high product quality certifications, rapid customization and delivery, and integrated one-stop packaging services that enhance brand value and meet diverse customer needs.
